t: This is New Road, which follows the line of an old toll road built across fields around the northern edge of London. The first part opened in 1756, and the route is now the A501. Two people are recorded as dying along it. Joseph Foveaux was a soldier and administrator of convict settlements in New South Wales, and by 1800 was the colony's largest landholder. Charles Catton was a painter of coaches, landscapes, animals and figures, and one of the founder members of the Royal Academy of Arts.
